Name: JM Room Partitions
Author: jawesome9235
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]JM Room Partitions[/b] lets you build walkable indoor room layouts with placeable partition walls and matching doorways. The walls block movement, while the open doorways let characters pass through beneath the wall header.

- To keep shop and catalogue menus uncluttered, this mod’s items now appear exclusively in [b][color=#ffff00]JM Furniture Catalogue[/color][/b] when it is installed, instead of Robin’s shop and Furniture Catalogue.
- [b][color=#ffff00]JM Furniture Catalogue [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]i[/color]s optional; without it, the items remain available through Robin as before.
- You can purchase [b][color=#ffff00]JM Furniture Catalogue[/color][/b] from Robin’s shop for 30,000g.
[b][color=#ffff00]JM Furniture Catalogue:[/color] [/b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53708

[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer.[/*]
[*]Remove any older JM Room Partitions folder from your Mods directory. Do not load both versions together.[/*]
[*]Extract the download and place the single JM Room Partitions folder in Mods[/*]
[/list]Existing walls and doorways keep their item IDs, so they remain recognizable in existing saves.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]13 wall styles, each with a matching doorway.[/*]
[*]Place walls freely indoors. Walls block movement; doorways allow passage.[/*]
[*]Matching pieces automatically connect into straight runs and corners.[/*]
[*]Doorways can be placed over rugs and floor objects. Objects that block movement still retain their collision.[/*]
[*]Click a doorway’s header or frame to pick it up; click through the opening to select a rug underneath.[/*]
[*]Furniture names are available in Chinese, English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, and Korean.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer[/*]
[/list]No Content Patcher is required. If [b]JM Furniture Catalogue[/b] is installed, the items appear in its [i]Other Decorations[/i] section. Otherwise, find them in Robin’s Furniture Catalogue.
